 "rationale": "Gain: the folded cascode gives about 70 dB and the CS stage about 37 dB, so 105 dB total. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc), about 8 MHz. p2 = gm7/CL, about 4x GBW, and Rz sets an LHP zero, so PM should be about 70 deg. The CS output gives rail-to-rail-ish swing over 1.2 V. Currents: Iref 10 + 3 bias branches 30 + tail 16 + folding 2x16 + 2nd stage 100 = 188 uA, about 340 uW."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair L
    "itail": (16e-6, 8e-6, 40e-6),   # tail current
    "icasc": (8e-6, 4e-6, 20e-6),    # cascode-branch current
    "i7":    (100e-6, 50e-6, 180e-6),# 2nd-stage current
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),      # PMOS current sources / loads
    "L_p":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_n": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # NMOS cascode-mirror bottom + M7
    "L_n":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "cc":    (2e-12, 1e-12, 4e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", vdd / 2)
    CL = spec.get("cl", 5e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    ib = iref                                  # bias-branch current
    it, ic, i7 = p["itail"], p["icasc"], p["i7"]
    itop = it / 2 + ic

    def diode(dev, target, L, I):
        best = None
        hi = 14.0 if dev == "p" else 18.0
        for g in np.linspace(2.0, hi, 49):
            try:
                op = lut.size(dev, float(g), L, I, vds=target)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if best is None or abs(op.vgs - target) < abs(best.vgs - target):
                best = op
        return best

    # ---- NMOS bias mirror (ibias diode -> tail, bias-branch sinks)
    gmid_t, L_t = 12.0, 1.0
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_t, L_t, iref, vds=0.7)
    Wn_u = mref.W / iref                       # W per amp, exact ratios

    # ---- input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.8, vsb=0.2)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs

    # ---- PMOS current sources (vbp1 diode reference)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ib, vds=0.6)
    Wp_u = mpd.W / ib
    mtop = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], itop, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], i7, vds=0.9)

    # ---- PMOS cascode + its bias
    vsb_p = mtop.vdsat + 0.15
    mcp = lut.size("p", 12.0, 0.5, ic, vds=0.6, vsb=vsb_p)
    vbp2 = vdd - vsb_p - mcp.vgs
    mpd2 = diode("p", vdd - vbp2, 1.0, ib)

    # ---- NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror + its bias
    mnb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], ic, vds=0.3)
    vx = mnb.vdsat + 0.12
    mnc = lut.size("n", 12.0, 0.5, ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vx)
    vbn2 = vx + mnc.vgs
    mnd2 = diode("n", vbn2, 1.0, ib)

    # ---- 2nd stage: M7 same gm/Id & L as mirror bottom -> Vgs matches o1 DC
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], i7, vds=0.9)
    Wnb_u = mnb.W / ic

    Cc = p["cc"]
    Rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_u * iref, L_t)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_u * it, L_t)
    n.M("MB1", "vbp1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_u * ib, L_t)
    n.M("MB2", "vbp2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_u * ib, L_t)
    n.M("MPD", "vbp1", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_u * ib, p["L_p"])
    n.dev("MPD2", "vbp2", "vbp2", "vdd", "vdd", mpd2)
    n.M("MB3", "vbn2", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_u * ib, p["L_p"])
    n.dev("MND2", "vbn2", "vbn2", "vss", "vss", mnd2)
    # input pair (o1 on vinp side -> vinp non-inverting after CS inversion)
    n.dev("M1", "f1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "f2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # folding PMOS sources
    n.M("MP1", "f1", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_u * itop, p["L_p"])
    n.M("MP2", "f2", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_u * itop, p["L_p"])
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("MC1", "o1", "vbp2", "f1", "vdd", mcp)
    n.dev("MC2", "nd", "vbp2", "f2", "vdd", mcp)
    # NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror (diode side = nd)
    n.dev("MNC1", "o1", "vbn2", "x1", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("MNC2", "nd", "vbn2", "x2", "vss", mnc)
    n.M("MNB1", "x1", "nd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wnb_u * ic, p["L_n"])
    n.M("MNB2", "x2", "nd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wnb_u * ic, p["L_n"])
    # second stage
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wnb_u * i7, p["L_n"])
    n.M("M8", "vout", "vbp1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp_u * i7, p["L_p"])
    # Miller compensation with nulling resistor
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions
    ro_top = 1.0 / (mtop.gds + m1.gds)
    Rup = (mcp.gm + mcp.gmbs) / mcp.gds * ro_top
    Rdn = (mnc.gm + mnc.gmbs) / mnc.gds / mnb.gds
    R1 = Rup * Rdn / (Rup + Rdn)
    A1 = m1.gm * R1
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = mcp.cdd + mnc.cdd + m7.cgg
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + CL * Cc + C1 * CL))
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)
    zlhp = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1) if C1 > 0 else 1e15
    pfold = mcp.gm / (2 * PI * (m1.cdd + mtop.cdd + mcp.cgg))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / zlhp)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pfold))
    itot = iref + 3 * ib + it + 2 * itop + i7
    power = vdd * itot
    swing = vdd - m8.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    slew = min(it / Cc, i7 / (CL + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew, "vtail": vtail}
